text: Built my first stall with B in my own settlement (tick ~9550); objective 'Build a market stall' completed correctly from my build. Within ~2s the Market Info shows 'Merchants: Linda Smith' - a resident bought the stall I just built. Before that, 20s of waiting with 5 residents left the market at 0/4 (no resident-built stalls).

Sell Resources in my own camp right after building a stall: red error 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 0 coins, and your cheapest good (sapling) sells for 19.' Clear message, but my freshly-made merchant (Linda Smith) has no coins, so selling is impossible at my own market.

Send Caravan (Town era) button in a Camp: clicking says 'This settlement needs a Storehouse before it can send caravans. The Storehouse is unlocked in the Town era.' Clear, but my goal (Storehouse + caravan) needs Town era (3rd of 4), out of reach in a 30-min session.

Back home at tick ~13160: market still 1/4 stalls (only the one I built), merchant Linda Smith still 0 coins, so Sell Resources/Purchase Food at my own market remain unusable. Settlement name banner text is drawn huge behind the HUD and cut off at the top edge.
